name: Blaine Fitzgerald
source:
Blaine isn't all too dissimilar to the [url=https://vndb.org/c148291]MC[/url]. A one-track mind for football. Despite coming from old money, he's never accepted the proposed offers from top schools that came based only on his last name before he'd even played a snap in high school. That 1st round projection was the fruition of the work he'd put in the last two seasons. Quiet, confrontational, but the face of Texas A&N.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]
